output.title: Read an invoice in twenty-five seconds

lines.speaker: lead
lines.text: No way. I paid the same invoice twice?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every invoice carries a unique number, in sequence. Mia never checked it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next, the date, then who bills whom: both names and addresses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then what was sold, how much, and the price before tax.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Last, the VAT rate and the VAT amount.

lines.speaker: lead
lines.text: Same number as last month. Caught it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Check the number first. Then pay once.

sources.title: Council Directive 2006/112/EC (EU VAT Directive), Article 226
sources.supports: Details an invoice must show: (1) date of issue, (2) a sequential number that uniquely identifies it, (5) full names and addresses of supplier and customer, (6) quantity and nature of the goods or services, (8) taxable amount, (9) VAT rate, (10) VAT amount payable.
